provenance.instrument: Abington Township Zoning Ordinance 2017 (Ord. No. 2136, Chapter 162), published on eCode360 as an ordinance PDF with later amending ordinances
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 does not hold Chapter 162 as section text. The chapter page lists the 2017 Zoning Ordinance PDF and amending ordinances. The amendments listed through Ord. 2237 (adopted 2025-12-11) were read for ADU changes. None touches Use A-1. Ord. 2215 restated the R1 to R4 dimensional tables for life care and nursing home rows.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 09-11-2025. The Chapter 162 page also lists Ord. 2237 (adopted 2025-12-11, nonconforming buildings).
checks: ADU occupants must be relatives: a parent, grandparent, or a spouse, partner or sibling of one of them (2103.A Use A-1, 2.c(2))
The ADU may be occupied only while the lot owner's family lives in the main house (Use A-1, 2.c(1))
Only accessory to a single-family detached house. One ADU per property
On lots under 10,000 sq ft the ADU must be attached to the house (Use A-1, 2.d(3))
A detached ADU is capped at 625 sq ft with one bedroom, a kitchen and a full bath. The code sets no size cap for an attached unit
The ADU must be at least 10 ft from all lot lines, or the district setback if greater
Utilities must connect through the main house. No separate address or mailbox
Materials, window ratio and roof pitch must match the main house
The permit lasts one year at most. It needs yearly renewal with a Zoning Officer inspection and ends when occupancy changes
Use A-1 sets no height, so the district 35 ft is the supported number. A Residential Accessory Structure (Use A-22) is one story and 17 ft. The Zoning Hearing Board could apply that by analogy. Ask
The district 'Minimum Separation for Residential Dwellings' (R1 40, R2 30, R3 24, R4 20 ft) may apply between the house and a detached ADU
Parking: 2 spaces for the house not counting the garage, plus 1 for the ADU. A single-car garage does not count

Separate path: as a special exception the Zoning Hearing Board may treat two related housekeeping units as one family, one unit with at most two people and one aged 60 or more, with a recorded removal agreement (Article II 'Family')
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Code Enforcement Division, https://abingtonpa.gov/departments/fire-and-emergency-management-services/code-enforcement-division. The land use page says there are no active zoning amendment applications and lists no township-requested amendments. No pending ADU ordinance found. The use matrix appendix is titled 'Abington Comprehensive Use Matrix Draft' in the adopted 2017 PDF.

term.note: 'Use A-1 Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs). A suite, either detached from or attached to the primary dwelling unit on the lot.'

status.note: Relatives only, by special exception in R1 to R4. 'All ADU occupants must be one of the following: A parent, grandparent, or a spouse, partner or sibling'

path.section: Use Matrix row A-1, Article XX, Article II 'Special Exception'
path.note: Matrix marks A-1 'SE' in R1, R2, R3, R4 and the LP Overlay. Special exceptions are decided by the Zoning Hearing Board.

fallback_path.section: Use Matrix row A-1, Article XX
fallback_path.note: Reading: an ADU outside the listed districts, or one that misses a Use A-1 standard, needs a variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

value.condition: ADUs on lots under 10,000 sq ft must be attached to the house. Detached and garage forms need a lot of 10,000 sq ft or more.
A detached ADU may have no more than one bedroom, with a kitchen and full bath.
The ADU permit lasts one year at most. It must be renewed every year after a Zoning Officer inspection. It expires when occupancy changes.
Reading (secondary): the district minimum separation between residential dwellings may apply between the house and a detached ADU. R1 40 ft, R2 30 ft, R3 24 ft, R4 20 ft.
Occupants must be a parent, grandparent, or a spouse, partner or sibling of one of them.
The lot owner's family must live in the main house.
Materials, window ratio and roof pitch must match the main house. No separate address or mailbox.
Utilities must connect through the main house systems.

zoning_districts.note: SE in R1, R2, R3, R4 and LP Overlay. 'N' in BC Noble and BC Willow Grove Park. Blank in the other districts.

building_types.note: 'An ADU is only permitted when accessory to a single-family detached dwelling.'

min_lot_sqft.note: No minimum lot for an ADU. 'ADUs on lots less than 10,000 square feet must be attached to the principal dwelling.'

existing_structure_only.note: A suite 'either detached from or attached to the primary dwelling unit'. New construction is not barred.

historic_bypass.note: No historic rule in Use A-1.

types_allowed.note: Reading: a suite attached to or detached from the house. Section 3 speaks of 'Detached ADUs, and homes expanded to accommodate ADUs'. Above a garage is not addressed. Lots under 10,000 sq ft: attached only.

max_sqft.note: No cap for every form. The 625 sq ft cap is for a detached ADU only.

max_sqft_internal.note: No size cap is stated for an attached unit.

max_height_ft.note: Use A-1 sets no height, so the district 35 ft applies. A-22 (17 ft, one story) covers structures for 'storage or vehicular parking'. The Zoning Hearing Board could apply it by analogy.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'ADUs must be set back at least 10 feet from all lot lines, or the district setback, whichever is greater.'

accessory_height_applies.note: Reading: A-22 is defined as a structure 'used for common household purposes, storage or vehicular parking'. An ADU is its own use A-1.

setback_front_ft.note: 'at least 10 feet from all lot lines, or the district setback, whichever is greater'. District front yards are larger. See districts.

setback_side_ft.note: 10 ft or the district side yard, whichever is greater. All R district side yards are 10 ft or more. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: 10 ft or the district rear yard, whichever is greater. See districts.

separation_ft.note: Varies by district. 'Minimum Separation for Residential Dwellings' R1 40, R2 30, R3 24, R4 20 ft. Reading: may apply between the house and a detached ADU. See districts.

max_building_coverage.note: Varies by district: R1 20%, R2 25%, R3 30%, R4 40%. See districts.

max_impervious.note: Varies by district: R1 25%, R2 35%, R3 40%, R4 55%.

occupancy.value: Relatives only: a parent, grandparent, or a spouse, partner or sibling of one of them, while the owner's family lives in the main house.

owner_occupancy.note: 'An ADU may be occupied only when the lot owner's family is living in the principal dwelling on the lot.' Owner's family, not the owner by name.

family_only.note: 'All ADU occupants must be one of the following: A parent, grandparent, or a spouse, partner or sibling of one of the those relatives.'

short_term_rental_banned.note: Intent: 'Prohibit the creation of rental units in Accessory Dwelling Units.' Occupants must be relatives.

max_adus.note: 'No more than one (1) ADU will be permitted on any property.'

sale_apart_allowed.note: Separate sale is not addressed. 'The ADU must not have a separate address or mailbox from the principal dwelling.'

total_on_site.note: House: '2 parking spaces exclusive of garage space' (H-7, page 245), plus 1 for the ADU (page 240).

reading.value: 3 in total: 2 for the house not counting the garage, plus 1 for the ADU. 'Single-car garages may not be utilized as required parking spaces.'

spaces_required.note: 'Use A-1: Accessory Dwelling Units (ADU). One (1) additional space is required.' Single-family detached needs 2 spaces not counting the garage (2304).

new_connection_required.note: ADUs connect to the systems serving the main house. 'No separate utility systems or connections shall be constructed or used'.

setback_front_ft.note: Corner lots may reduce one front yard.

setback_side_ft.note: Minimum side yard, two required. An ADU must also be 10 ft or more from every lot line (2103.A Use A-1, 2.d(4)).

separation_ft.note: 'Minimum Separation for Residential Dwellings'. Reading: may apply between the house and a detached ADU.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 35 ft for all uses except life care and nursing homes.
